content:
# Technical Research Report: Base Apple Silicon Chips (M3, M4, M5) This report covers verified technical specifications and benchmark performance strictly for the **base variants** of Apple Silicon: **M3**, **M4**, and **M5** (excluding Pro, Max, and Ultra). --- ## 1. Apple M3 (Base) | # | Specification / Metric | Value & Details | Authoritative Source | |---|---|---|---| | **1** | **Process Node** | **TSMC 3nm (N3B)** — TSMC’s first-generation 3-nanometer lithography process. | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2023/10/apple-unveils-m3-m3-pro-and-m3-max-the-most-advanced-chips-for-a-personal-computer/) / [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Apple-M3-Processor-Benchmarks-and-Specs.765668.0.html) | | **2** | **Transistor Count** | **25 billion transistors** | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2023/10/apple-unveils-m3-m3-pro-and-m3-max-the-most-advanced-chips-for-a-personal-computer/) | | **3** | **CPU Core Configuration** | **8 cores total**: 4 Performance cores ("Shenandoah") + 4 Efficiency cores ("Sawtooth") | [Apple Support Specs](https://support.apple.com/en-us/117737) | | **4** | **CPU Clock Speeds** | • **Performance Cores:** Up to **4.05 GHz**
• **Efficiency Cores:** Up to **2.75 GHz** | [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Apple-M3-Processor-Benchmarks-and-Specs.765668.0.html) | | **5** | **GPU Core Count** | **8-core or 10-core GPU** with Dynamic Caching, hardware-accelerated ray tracing, and hardware mesh shading | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2023/10/apple-unveils-m3-m3-pro-and-m3-max-the-most-advanced-chips-for-a-personal-computer/) | | **6** | **Neural Engine TOPS** | **18 TOPS** (16-core Neural Engine) | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2023/10/apple-unveils-m3-m3-pro-and-m3-max-the-most-advanced-chips-for-a-personal-computer/) | | **7** | **Memory Bandwidth** | **100 GB/s** (128-bit bus, LPDDR5-6400 unified memory) | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2023/10/apple-unveils-m3-m3-pro-and-m3-max-the-most-advanced-chips-for-a-personal-computer/) | | **8** | **Memory Configurations Available** | **8 GB, 16 GB, or 24 GB** unified memory | [Apple Support Specs](https://support.apple.com/en-us/117737) | | **9** | **Media Engine Capabilities** | • Hardware-accelerated H.264, HEVC, ProRes, and ProRes RAW
• Video decode engine & video encode engine
• ProRes encode and decode engine
• **AV1 decode engine** *(Note: AV1 encode is NOT supported)* | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2023/10/apple-unveils-m3-m3-pro-and-m3-max-the-most-advanced-chips-for-a-personal-computer/) | | **10** | **Thunderbolt Version** | **Thunderbolt 3 / USB4** (up to 40 Gb/s data transfer rate) | [Apple Support Specs](https://support.apple.com/en-us/117737) | | **11** | **Max External Display Support** | • **1 external display** up to 6K @ 60Hz with laptop open
• **Up to 2 external displays** (one 6K @ 60Hz + one 5K @ 60Hz) with laptop lid closed (clamshell mode) | [Apple Support Display Guidelines](https://support.apple.com/en-us/117373) | | **12** | **Geekbench 6 Scores** | • **Single-Core:** **~3,100 – 3,200**
• **Multi-Core:** **~11,800 – 12,050** | [Geekbench Browser](https://browser.geekbench.com/) / [Laptop Mag](https://www.laptopmag.com/) | | **13** | **Cinebench Scores** | • **Cinebench 2024:** ~140–142 Single-Core / ~620–650 Multi-Core
• **Cinebench R23:** ~1,900–1,910 Single-Core / ~10,250–10,450 Multi-Core | [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Apple-M3-Processor-Benchmarks-and-Specs.765668.0.html) | | **14** | **GPU Benchmarks (Metal Compute)** | **~47,000 – 48,000** (Geekbench 6 Metal score, 10-core GPU) | [Geekbench Browser](https://browser.geekbench.com/) / [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/) | | **15** | **Power Consumption / TDP** | *Not publicly disclosed by Apple.*
Third-party testing measures package TDP at **~20W peak** under CPU load, settling to **~15W sustained** in fanless MacBook Air chassis. | [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/) / [CPU-Monkey](https://www.cpu-monkey.com/) | | **16** | **Battery Life in MacBook Air** | • Up to **18 hours** Apple TV app movie playback
• Up to **15 hours** wireless web | [Apple MacBook Air Tech Specs](https://support.apple.com/en-us/117737) | | **17** | **Release / Announcement Date** | • Chip & MacBook Pro 14" announced: **October 30, 2023**; released **November 7, 2023**
• MacBook Air 13" & 15" announced: **March 4, 2024**; released **March 8, 2024** | [Apple Newsroom M3](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2023/10/apple-unveils-m3-m3-pro-and-m3-max-the-most-advanced-chips-for-a-personal-computer/) / [Apple Newsroom Air](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2024/03/apple-unveils-the-new-13-and-15-inch-macbook-air-with-the-powerful-m3-chip/) | | **18** | **MacBook Models Using M3 Base** | • **MacBook Pro (14-inch, Nov 2023)**
• **MacBook Air (13-inch, M3, March 2024)**
• **MacBook Air (15-inch, M3, March 2024)** | [Apple Support Specs](https://support.apple.com/en-us/117737) | --- ## 2. Apple M4 (Base) | # | Specification / Metric | Value & Details | Authoritative Source | |---|---|---|---| | **1** | **Process Node** | **TSMC 3nm (N3E)** — TSMC’s second-generation 3-nanometer technology. | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2024/05/apple-introduces-m4-chip/) / [Tom's Hardware](https://www.tomshardware.com/pc-components/cpus/apple-m4-chip) | | **2** | **Transistor Count** | **28 billion transistors** | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2024/05/apple-introduces-m4-chip/) | | **3** | **CPU Core Configuration** | • **Mac / Full Config:** **10 cores total**: 4 Performance cores + 6 Efficiency cores
• *Binned Entry Variants:* 8 cores total (4P + 4E on entry iMac) or 9 cores (3P + 6E on entry iPad Pro 256/512GB) | [Apple Support Specs](https://support.apple.com/en-us/121547) / [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2024/10/apple-introduces-new-macbook-pro-featuring-the-incredibly-powerful-m4-family-of-chips/) | | **4** | **CPU Clock Speeds** | • **Performance Cores:** Up to **4.40 – 4.51 GHz** (typically cited ~4.4 GHz peak)
• **Efficiency Cores:** Up to **2.89 – 2.90 GHz** | [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Apple-M4-Processor-Benchmarks-and-Specs.836173.0.html) / [Geekerwan](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV11S411T7mE/) | | **5** | **GPU Core Count** | **8-core or 10-core GPU** with Dynamic Caching, hardware-accelerated ray tracing, and mesh shading | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2024/05/apple-introduces-m4-chip/) | | **6** | **Neural Engine TOPS** | **38 TOPS** (16-core Neural Engine) | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2024/05/apple-introduces-m4-chip/) | | **7** | **Memory Bandwidth** | **120 GB/s** (128-bit bus, LPDDR5X-7500 unified memory) | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2024/05/apple-introduces-m4-chip/) | | **8** | **Memory Configurations Available** | **16 GB, 24 GB, or 32 GB** unified memory *(Apple raised base entry RAM from 8 GB to 16 GB)* | [Apple Support Specs](https://support.apple.com/en-us/121547) | | **9** | **Media Engine Capabilities** | • Hardware-accelerated H.264, HEVC, ProRes, and ProRes RAW
• Video decode engine & video encode engine
• ProRes encode and decode engine
• **AV1 decode engine** *(Note: AV1 encode is NOT supported)* | [Apple Support Specs](https://support.apple.com/en-us/121547) | | **10** | **Thunderbolt Version** | **Thunderbolt 4 / USB4** (up to 40 Gb/s) on base M4 MacBook Pro/Air *(Thunderbolt 5 is exclusive to M4 Pro and M4 Max chips)* | [Apple Support Specs](https://support.apple.com/en-us/121547) | | **11** | **Max External Display Support** | • **Up to 2 external displays** with up to 6K resolution at 60Hz over Thunderbolt **with the built-in display open/active**
• Or one external display up to 6K @ 60Hz and one external display up to 4K @ 144Hz via HDMI; also supports one 8K @ 60Hz display over HDMI | [Apple Support Specs](https://support.apple.com/en-us/121547) | | **12** | **Geekbench 6 Scores** | • **Single-Core:** **~3,800 – 3,880**
• **Multi-Core:** **~14,500 – 14,900** (10-core config) | [Geekbench Browser](https://browser.geekbench.com/) / [Tom's Hardware](https://www.tomshardware.com/pc-components/cpus/apple-m4-chip) | | **13** | **Cinebench Scores** | • **Cinebench 2024:** ~172–178 Single-Core / ~940–980 Multi-Core
• **Cinebench R23:** ~2,250–2,300 Single-Core / ~13,500–14,000 Multi-Core | [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Apple-M4-Processor-Benchmarks-and-Specs.836173.0.html) / [CPU-Monkey](https://www.cpu-monkey.com/) | | **14** | **GPU Benchmarks (Metal Compute)** | • **~57,000 – 58,000** (Geekbench 6 Metal score on actively cooled MacBook Pro 14")
• ~53,500 on passively cooled iPad Pro | [Geekbench Browser](https://browser.geekbench.com/) / [Wccftech](https://wccftech.com/) | | **15** | **Power Consumption / TDP** | *Not publicly disclosed by Apple.*
Third-party testing reveals **5W–18W** sustained in MacBook Air, bursting up to **~28W–30W peak package power** in actively cooled MacBook Pro / Mac mini under combined full CPU/GPU load. | [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Apple-M4-Processor-Benchmarks-and-Specs.836173.0.html) / [Geekerwan](https://www.bilibili.com/) | | **16** | **Battery Life in MacBook Air** | • Up to **18 hours** Apple TV app movie playback
• Up to **15 hours** wireless web | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/03/apple-introduces-the-new-macbook-air-with-the-m4-chip/) | | **17** | **Release / Announcement Date** | • Initial Chip Debut (iPad Pro): **May 7, 2024**; released **May 15, 2024**
• Mac Debut (MacBook Pro 14", iMac, Mac mini): **October 30, 2024**; released **November 8, 2024**
• MacBook Air 13" & 15" announced: **March 5, 2025**; released **March 12, 2025** | [Apple Newsroom M4 Debut](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2024/05/apple-introduces-m4-chip/) / [Apple Newsroom M4 Mac](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2024/10/apple-introduces-new-macbook-pro-featuring-the-incredibly-powerful-m4-family-of-chips/) / [Apple Newsroom Air](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/03/apple-introduces-the-new-macbook-air-with-the-m4-chip/) | | **18** | **MacBook Models Using M4 Base** | • **MacBook Pro (14-inch, M4, late 2024)**
• **MacBook Air (13-inch, M4, March 2025)**
• **MacBook Air (15-inch, M4, March 2025)** | [Apple Support Specs](https://support.apple.com/en-us/121547) | --- ## 3. Apple M5 (Base) | # | Specification / Metric | Value & Details | Authoritative Source | |---|---|---|---| | **1** | **Process Node** | **TSMC 3nm (N3P)** — TSMC’s third-generation 3-nanometer process node. | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/10/apple-unveils-m5-chip/) / [Tom's Hardware](https://www.tomshardware.com/) | | **2** | **Transistor Count** | **Not publicly disclosed by Apple** *(Third-party industry estimates range from ~28 billion to nearly 40 billion transistors).* | [Tech Between The Lines](https://techbetweenthelines.com/) / [Magzter](https://www.magzter.com/) | | **3** | **CPU Core Configuration** | **10 cores total**: 4 Performance cores ("Super cores") + 6 Efficiency cores *(binned 9-core variants in certain entry configs)* | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/10/apple-unveils-m5-chip/) | | **4** | **CPU Clock Speeds** | • **Performance Cores:** Up to **4.61 GHz** (typically cited ~4.6 GHz in MacBook Pro)
• **Efficiency Cores:** Up to **~3.0 GHz** | [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/) / [Wccftech](https://wccftech.com/) | | **5** | **GPU Core Count** | **8-core or 10-core GPU** featuring **dedicated Neural Accelerators inside each GPU core** and third-generation hardware-accelerated ray tracing | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/10/apple-unveils-m5-chip/) | | **6** | **Neural Engine TOPS** | **Not publicly disclosed by Apple** *(Apple shifted messaging away from standalone NPU TOPS to highlight on-chip GPU Neural Accelerators delivering >4x peak GPU AI compute over M4; third-party estimations range from 25 to 45 TOPS for the NPU block alone).* | [Apple Support / Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/10/apple-unveils-m5-chip/) | | **7** | **Memory Bandwidth** | **153 GB/s** (~28% increase over M4, utilizing high-speed LPDDR5X) | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/10/apple-unveils-m5-chip/) | | **8** | **Memory Configurations Available** | **16 GB, 24 GB, or 32 GB** unified memory *(12 GB in select entry/tablet SKUs; 16 GB standard Mac baseline)* | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/10/apple-unveils-m5-chip/) / [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apple_silicon) | | **9** | **Media Engine Capabilities** | • Hardware-accelerated H.264, HEVC, ProRes, and ProRes RAW
• Dedicated video decode and encode engines
• ProRes encode and decode engine
• **AV1 decode engine** *(Note: Hardware AV1 encode was introduced on M5 Pro/Max, but is NOT present on the base M5)* | [Apple Support Specs](https://support.apple.com/) / [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/10/apple-unveils-m5-chip/) | | **10** | **Thunderbolt Version** | **Thunderbolt 4 / USB4** (up to 40 Gb/s) on MacBook Air; **Thunderbolt 5** (up to 80/120 Gb/s) on base 14" MacBook Pro models | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/10/apple-unveils-m5-chip/) / [MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/) | | **11** | **Max External Display Support** | **Up to 2 external displays** (up to 6K @ 60Hz) simultaneously alongside the built-in laptop display | [Apple Support Docs](https://support.apple.com/) | | **12** | **Geekbench 6 Scores** | • **Single-Core:** **~4,260 – 4,310**
• **Multi-Core:** **~17,800 – 17,870** | [Geekbench Browser](https://browser.geekbench.com/) / [CPU-Monkey](https://www.cpu-monkey.com/) | | **13** | **Cinebench Scores** | • **Cinebench 2024:** ~200–215 Single-Core / ~1,250–1,300 Multi-Core
• **Cinebench 2026 (updated suite):** ~737 Single-Core / ~4,370 Multi-Core
• *Cinebench R23:* Legacy suite; not officially run by Apple or modern reviewers, estimated >16,000 multi-core. | [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/) / [CPU-Monkey](https://www.cpu-monkey.com/) | | **14** | **GPU Benchmarks (Metal Compute)** | **~76,100 – 76,140** (Geekbench 6 Metal score, 10-core GPU in MacBook Pro) | [Geekbench Browser](https://browser.geekbench.com/) / [Beebom](https://beebom.com/) | | **15** | **Power Consumption / TDP** | *Not publicly disclosed by Apple.*
Third-party testing indicates **~23W–27.5W sustained (PL1)** and **~30.5W burst (PL2)**, with the GPU accounting for ~17W–19W TDP under graphics stress. | [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/) | | **16** | **Battery Life in MacBook Air** | • Up to **18 hours** video streaming (Apple TV app)
• Up to **15 hours** wireless web | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/) / [Apple Support](https://support.apple.com/) | | **17** | **Release / Announcement Date** | • Chip Debut & MacBook Pro 14" M5 announced: **October 15, 2025**; released **October 22, 2025**
• MacBook Air 13" & 15" M5 announced: **March 2026** | [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/10/apple-unveils-m5-chip/) | | **18** | **MacBook Models Using M5 Base** | • **MacBook Pro (14-inch, M5, late 2025)**
• **MacBook Air (13-inch, M5, Spring 2026)**
• **MacBook Air (15-inch, M5, Spring 2026)** | [Apple Support Specs](https://support.apple.com/) | --- ## 4. Side-by-Side Comparison Summary | Metric | Apple M3 (Base) | Apple M4 (Base) | Apple M5 (Base) | |---|---|---|---| | **Process Node** | TSMC N3B (3nm) | TSMC N3E (3nm) | TSMC N3P (3nm) | | **Transistor Count** | 25 Billion | 28 Billion | *Not publicly disclosed* (~28B–40B est.) | | **CPU Cores** | 8 cores (4P + 4E) | 10 cores (4P + 6E)* | 10 cores (4P + 6E) | | **Peak P-Core Clock** | ~4.05 GHz | ~4.41–4.51 GHz | ~4.61 GHz | | **Peak E-Core Clock** | ~2.75 GHz | ~2.90 GHz | ~3.00 GHz | | **GPU Cores** | 8 or 10 cores | 8 or 10 cores | 8 or 10 cores | | **NPU TOPS** | 18 TOPS | 38 TOPS | *Not publicly disclosed* (>4x GPU AI compute) | | **Memory Bandwidth** | 100 GB/s | 120 GB/s | 153 GB/s | | **Base / Max Memory** | 8 GB / 24 GB | 16 GB / 32 GB | 16 GB / 32 GB | | **AV1 Codec Support** | Decode only | Decode only | Decode only (Encode on Pro/Max) | | **Thunderbolt** | Thunderbolt 3 / USB4 | Thunderbolt 4 / USB4 | Thunderbolt 4 / Thunderbolt 5 | | **Max External Displays** | 1 open (or 2 closed) | 2 open simultaneously | 2 open simultaneously | | **Geekbench 6 Single-Core**| ~3,150 | ~3,850 | ~4,285 | | **Geekbench 6 Multi-Core** | ~11,900 | ~14,700 | ~17,850 | | **Geekbench 6 Metal Score**| ~47,500 | ~57,500 | ~76,120 | | **MacBook Air Battery Life**| 18h video / 15h web | 18h video / 15h web | 18h video / 15h web | | **MacBook Models** | Air 13", Air 15", Pro 14" | Air 13", Air 15", Pro 14" | Air 13", Air 15", Pro 14" | *\*Note: Entry iPad Pro and iMac variants of M4 feature binned 9-core and 8-core CPU configurations respectively.* --- ## 5.
